existing_authority.rule: Reuse the existing unused single MINUS continuation allocation and exact independently reviewed private bindings. This contract adds no solver start, changes no predecessor and does not reopen scientific binding review.

binding.privacy: Keep binding payloads private and unmodified. Publish hashes and execution metadata only.

launcher_preparation.reuse_reference: Existing HALF_PLUS launch_001/launcher.py SHA33d5dc2571064dca4714cd4674dfaa8e6cd9192aabbed8bf5f840260d33be502 may be copied read-only and adapted mechanically for exact MINUS case/paths/hashes and predecessor-order checks. Do not modify that active launcher.
launcher_preparation.fixture: Using fake processes/terminal receipts only: active HALF_PLUS refuses; absent or unclassified HALF_PLUS terminal refuses; classified terminal with owner exit admits preparation; changed exact binding, existing output/raw, duplicate reservation, unavailable capacity or conflicting owner refuses. Fake Popen/kill only. No science invocation, even --help, in preparation.
launcher_preparation.stopping: One small implementation and one fixture invocation. First failure or out-of-scope change returns a concrete finding; no retry. Preserve cumulative preparation usage and all initial raw evidence.

serialized_release_preconditions: Original PLUS runtime abort has its independent terminal classification and its old observer/group is absent. It need not be falsely labeled scientifically complete.

Active HALF_PLUS reaches a natural actual terminal; preserve RETURN/checkpoint/external exit/time evidence, independently classify complete endpoint or typed resource stop, and verify state/terminal parity at its actual scope. A live PID, stale receipt or missing result is not terminal classification. Numerical/identity failure requires an explicit separate authority disposition before MINUS release.

HALF_PLUS observer, scientific group and launcher children have exited, distinguished from PID reuse by start identity. No active conflicting legacy dispatcher or pending exclusive PLUS/other scheduler reservation remains.

Reconcile all pending starts under one controller owner; serialized sequence advances only to MINUS, then HALF_MINUS after MINUS terminal classification. A separately prepared PLUS checkpoint recovery is not automatically launched by this contract.

Exact existing MINUS authority, private binding, mirrored authority binding, binary, source compatibility and original predecessor config/checkpoint/RETURN match reviewed identities. No existing MINUS continuation attempt, process acknowledgement, output/raw or reservation exists.

Fresh local+remote+pending science count including this reservation is at most two. Record actual remote observation and pending allocations; do not infer global absence from local process listing. Honor this serialized owner's exclusivity even when an arithmetic slot is free.

Record available affinity; CPU0 is prescribed, but a currently permitted different CPU may be selected and bound as an execution-only substitution. Require at least2GiB available memory for this slot and at least4GiB free disk plus existing-work margin. One thread only.

Fresh independent review accepts only new launcher/fixture and exact release preconditions; existing science/binding PASS remains scoped. Controller writes one RELEASE.json tied to actual launcher SHA, binding SHA, observed HALF_PLUS terminal/exit and current capacity/ownership before launch.

execution.reservation: Exclusively create new launch_001/RESERVATION.json before Popen, with carried cumulative accounting. Do not require launch_001 directory absent because preparation owns it; require runtime reservation/start/log paths absent. Do not precreate bound output/raw_output; executable owns them.
execution.process_ownership: Record Popen acknowledgement with PID/PGID/start identity immediately. Monitor exact owned process identity and resource totals. No all-argv substring scientific scan and no unrelated process action.
execution.output_counting: Count all scientific output files within3968MiB and all launcher/raw evidence including launch_001 within128MiB; combined4096MiB. Per-file fsize is additional to aggregate monitors. Existing original MINUS output remains separately charged under cumulative6144MiB allocation.

cumulative_start_accounting.rule: Reconcile actual current totals before reservation. Every intervening authorized PLUS recovery/AX11/other start adds to these numbers, never disappears. Preserve PLUS two attempts versus one observed start and unknown interrupted-tail costs separately. A pre-Popen failure consumes this reservation but is not an observed solver start. No failed-start retry is authorized.

transition: Launcher preparation PASS -> wait actual HALF_PLUS terminal classification and owner exit -> fresh scoped launcher review and controller release -> exactly one MINUS invocation. Endpoint or first resource/identity/numerical/output guard -> preserve raw result/checkpoint and actual terminal classification -> existing HALF_MINUS authority may be considered next, without automatically launching it.
claim_ceiling: Execution readiness only. No new physical/numerical model, no broader scientific admission, no full-history or convergence claim from launcher PASS.
